notes.title: Demo update for Ukrainian Games Festival
notes.content:
Dear guests, your journey through our eerie village is about to get a little better.

[h3][h2]What's new?[/h2][/h3]

[h2]1.Sound[/h2]

We've balanced the music, sounds, and voices. We also made them louder in general.

We remember that for some the sounds were too quiet. Now everything will be heard.

You can set the volume of all audio channels in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039258/57348eaf78674a20dbdf8b54ea00eda0ee7e13f8.png[/img]


[h2]2. Smoothness[/h2]

Now the journey through the village will be smoother, without jumps and sharp transitions.


[h2]3. New game icon[/h2]

Now you will find our story among others by this symbol. Do you recognize where it came from?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039258/0ba213fddc7e551a20a62d2b57891875dcb64b99.png[/img]


[h2]4. New cursor[/h2]

To help you make your choices with even more grace.


[h2]5. Active link to our Discord[/h2]

We still can't believe we've been keeping you out of our server's door for so long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039258/4a5f7a31d824fc1e2ae623dfafe89c9bcf4e715c.png[/img]


[h2]6. Credits[/h2]

There is a new addition to the village elders. Also, now you can watch the credits longer. We know that this is important to many of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039258/940dc1e8220f871626dcae960c64ea15e5784eb2.png[/img]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010620/_/]Try the demo and add What Remains to your wishlist.[/url][/h2]

notes.title: VIsual updates to UGF 2024
notes.content:
Some work miracles. They mix the colors of night, snow, and blood to depict new worlds—beautiful and terrifying, complex and ruthless, deep and incomprehensible.

Earlier, your gaze, dear guest, found our village thankt to a fire that burned all the choices and memories. It looked like this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039258/c7951d4957d37ccfe57c18fc4748b1dc1e674737.png[/img]

And now, the blood moon is burning over the village that holds its breath waiting for your steps. Beneath it, Goat, Granny, and Bear are waiting, ready to accompany you to the first khata and sing thair carols that will change fates. 

Here they are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039258/a429334e48ab2c24d79d16ea0c42e459e3f43143.png[/img]

We are grateful to our artist and QA tester for this outstanding work. Luka Hyde is the one whose work will draw you into the eerie village of What Remains.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010620/_/]Add the game to your wishlist.[/url]

notes.title: What Remains at Ukrainian Games Festival 2024
notes.content:
Dear guests of the eerie village!

Goat, Bear, and Granny have arrived at Ukrainian Games Festival 2024. In the upcoming week, you will hear our voices, whispers, and grumbles from all platforms.

We have prepared three big updates for you. Soon, the developers may also meet with you to tell more about the game's creation and content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039258/8a1093f13e87b3d9f995a977f5a11a1af30f8083.png[/img]

Thank you for your support and interest in What Remains. We welcome all those who have stepped into our world for the first time and those who have decided to stay here.

Follow the links so we don't lose each other ↓.

[url=https://discord.gg/SDtcEK6zQ3]Talk to us on Discord.[/url]

[url=https://x.com/CHICHKA_Games]Read each other's thoughts on Twitter (X).[/url]

[url=https://t.me/chichka_games]Or hit us up on Telegram. [/url]

Perhaps then we will disappear back into oblivion where we came from. But for now, we're here to entertain you in our strange way.
